name: Remote Transmitter → Transmit Ira211
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions/#all-actions) sends a Siemens IRA211 infrared remote code to a remote transmitter. `SYNC` and `POWER` frames carry the full state (temperature, mode and fan); `TEMP_UP`, `TEMP_DOWN`, `MODE` and `FAN` carry only the field they change, so the other values are ignored for those commands.

config_entries.label: Command
config_entries.description: The command to send. One of `TEMP_UP`, `TEMP_DOWN`, `MODE`, `FAN`, `POWER` or `SYNC`.

config_entries.label: Transmitter ID
config_entries.description: The remote transmitter to send the remote code with. Defaults to the first one defined in the configuration.

config_entries.label: Fan Mode
config_entries.description: The fan speed. One of `AUTO`, `LOW`, `MEDIUM` or `HIGH`. Defaults to `AUTO`.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: The operating mode. One of `PROTECTION`, `TIMER` or `COMFORT`. Defaults to `COMFORT`.

config_entries.label: Repeat
config_entries.description: Defines the number of times the code is repeated when transmitted. By default, codes are sent only once.

config_entries.label: Temperature
config_entries.description: The target temperature in °C, from `5` to `35` in `0.5` steps. Defaults to `20`.
